comment: very knowledgable about video and experimental film. if you do the work you'll be fine

Drummond has a lot of insight about different kinds of films and has a large knowledge of the components of film, but VMAP 117 wasn't what I was expecting. He was focused a lot on sound in video/film and image and experimental narrative. Not super dynamic and likes to hear himself talk. Did learn a lot about importance of sounds.
Really down to earth, chill guy. He acts like the students themselves, in many ways. An easy class and really interesting. Definitely recommended for anybody that has any interest in media.
Extremely helpful. He stayed after class several times just to help out. He really knows his stuff. I'd definitely recommend him.
Jeremy is extremely intelligent, helpful, and insightful, not to mention ridiculously attractive.
He is super chill and assigns interesting projects.  It is hard to get an A on a project, but if you work really hard and put a lot of effort into the class, you will end up getting an A.
Great arts professor! Take him and you'll learn a ton. Can be a tough grader at times but will help you out if you go to him.

Cool guy, he has kind of a quirky sense of humor about things.  He's pretty quite though so make sure you participate and get your class to open him up.  There are article discussions every once and a while and a little more work than you'd expect but it's a good class and he's really willing to help you figure out software and things like that.

Drummond is an all around great guy.  He is not only nice, but very intelligent, understanding, and insightful.  He is young, so he is very easy to relate to.  His digital art course is very interesting though some of the programs are difficult to learn.  He isn't an easy grader, but you learn how to perfect your work.
A LOT of work is involved in all of his classes.  especially the Audio/Video classes.  be prepared.  Very interesting.  He's a freakin genius!
